propositions: MCP gate resolvers mcp_readonly() and mcp_gate() silently collapse ConfigError from malformed rebar.toml into configured/default boolean values instead of raising an error per operator ruling 39f8-ae7c
The fail parameter in config.mcp_gate() exists only to provide a malformed-config fallback and should be removed as dead code once resolvers propagate errors
MCP error envelope and error_code_for() must classify ConfigError as config_unreadable and surface it in the structured envelope instead of a crash
runner_support._readonly_gate and mcp_server._mcp_gate consumers must propagate ConfigError without catching or collapsing it to a default
Readable config resolution behavior must remain byte-identical with file key honored and environment variables taking precedence
Documentation must reflect the new contract that unreadable/corrupt config produces an error, and gate_unreadable is historical-only
